title: Session 6: Synchronous and Asynchronous Programming in Dart

questions.questionText: In which programming style does the execution of one process depend on another process?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Synchronous.

questions.questionText: In the phone-call analogy, synchronous programming is like:
options: Making another call while on a call
Sending a text during a call
Being unable to start the next call until the present one ends
questions.correctAnswer: Being unable to start the next call until the present one ends
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Being unable to start the next call until the present one ends.

questions.questionText: The biggest disadvantage of synchronous programming is that:
options: It blocks the code until the previous process has finished
questions.correctAnswer: It blocks the code until the previous process has finished
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) It blocks the code until the previous process has finished.

questions.questionText: In a web server using synchronous processing:
options: All requests are handled at once
A new user’s request is blocked until the previous request completes
questions.correctAnswer: A new user’s request is blocked until the previous request completes
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A new user’s request is blocked until the previous request completes.

questions.questionText: Which function takes user input synchronously after importing dart:io?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) stdin.readLineSync().

questions.questionText: Which library must be imported to use stdin?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) dart:io.

questions.questionText: An asynchronous method executes:
options: In a thread that is not the main application thread
questions.correctAnswer: In a thread that is not the main application thread
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) In a thread that is not the main application thread.

questions.questionText: In asynchronous programming, the user can:
options: Move on to another task before the current one is completed
questions.correctAnswer: Move on to another task before the current one is completed
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Move on to another task before the current one is completed.

questions.questionText: In which library is the Future class available?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) dart:async.

questions.questionText: What does file.readAsString() return?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A Future<String>.

questions.questionText: In the file-reading example, which line prints first?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) main ends here.

questions.questionText: In f.then((data) => print(data));, the then() function runs:
options: After the asynchronous task completes with data
questions.correctAnswer: After the asynchronous task completes with data
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) After the asynchronous task completes with data.

questions.questionText: The Future keyword is used for:
options: Getting a value at some time in the future
questions.correctAnswer: Getting a value at some time in the future
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Getting a value at some time in the future.

questions.questionText: Future objects represent:
options: Values from an expression whose execution completes at a later point in time
questions.correctAnswer: Values from an expression whose execution completes at a later point in time
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Values from an expression whose execution completes at a later point in time.

questions.questionText: Which are the three states of a Future?
options: Uncompleted, completed with a value, completed with an error
questions.correctAnswer: Uncompleted, completed with a value, completed with an error
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Uncompleted, completed with a value, completed with an error.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a state of a Future?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Completed with value.

questions.questionText: Future.value() creates:
options: A future that completes with a value
questions.correctAnswer: A future that completes with a value
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) A future that completes with a value.

questions.questionText: What is printed by var myfutureval = Future.value(14); print(myfutureval);?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Instance of 'Future<int>'.

questions.questionText: Why does the above code print an instance of Future instead of 14?
options: await was not used to get the value
questions.correctAnswer: await was not used to get the value
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) await was not used to get the value.

questions.questionText: Future.error() creates a future that:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Completes with an error.

questions.questionText: Future.delayed() creates a future that:
options: Runs its computation after a delay
questions.correctAnswer: Runs its computation after a delay
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Runs its computation after a delay.

questions.questionText: Duration(milliseconds: 10000) equals a delay of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) 10 seconds.

questions.questionText: The async keyword is used to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Declare a function as asynchronous.

questions.questionText: When an async function is called, it returns:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) A Future.

questions.questionText: The await keyword can be used only:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) On/inside asynchronous functions.

questions.questionText: The await keyword:
options: Holds the currently running function until the result is ready
questions.correctAnswer: Holds the currently running function until the result is ready
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Holds the currently running function until the result is ready.

questions.questionText: In the await example, what is the console output?
options: Good Morning, then Have a great day!
questions.correctAnswer: Good Morning, then Have a great day!
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Good Morning, then Have a great day!.

questions.questionText: To use await inside main(), main() must be declared with:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) async.

questions.questionText: Which is an advantage of synchronous programming?
options: It is supported in all programming languages
questions.correctAnswer: It is supported in all programming languages
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) It is supported in all programming languages.

questions.questionText: Synchronous programs are generally:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Easier to write.

questions.questionText: Synchronous programs are considered reliable because:
options: Errors can be detected and handled before they cause significant damage
questions.correctAnswer: Errors can be detected and handled before they cause significant damage
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Errors can be detected and handled before they cause significant damage.

questions.questionText: A disadvantage of synchronous programming is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Slower program loading time.

questions.questionText: In synchronous programming, when a thread is locked:
options: The threads in the queue get blocked as well
questions.correctAnswer: The threads in the queue get blocked as well
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The threads in the queue get blocked as well.

questions.questionText: Synchronous programs require more threads to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Handle more requests.

questions.questionText: An advantage of asynchronous programming is that:
options: The application can continue executing while an asynchronous function performs its task
questions.correctAnswer: The application can continue executing while an asynchronous function performs its task
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The application can continue executing while an asynchronous function performs its task.

questions.questionText: Asynchronous programming helps by:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Decreasing page load delays.

questions.questionText: Callback functions in asynchronous programs help to:
options: Execute the next line of code if an error occurs
questions.correctAnswer: Execute the next line of code if an error occurs
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Execute the next line of code if an error occurs.

questions.questionText: The async and await keywords have a well-known syntax that lets asynchronous functions work with:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Promises.

questions.questionText: A disadvantage of asynchronous programming is that it is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Complex to write.

questions.questionText: Developers using asynchronous programming should have knowledge of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Callback and recursive functions.

questions.questionText: Too many asynchronous requests can:
options: Overload the server and slow program execution
questions.correctAnswer: Overload the server and slow program execution
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Overload the server and slow program execution.

questions.questionText: The guide concludes that choosing between synchronous and asynchronous programming should depend on:
options: The requirements of the software activity, as no style is universally better
questions.correctAnswer: The requirements of the software activity, as no style is universally better
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The requirements of the software activity, as no style is universally better.

questions.questionText: Asynchronous programming is said to:
options: Fix the chain of events in a programming cycle
questions.correctAnswer: Fix the chain of events in a programming cycle
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Fix the chain of events in a programming cycle.

questions.questionText: In which style is program loading time slower?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Synchronous.

questions.questionText: Which statement about asynchronous processes is correct per the summary?
options: Execution of one process does not depend on any other process
Execution always depends on another process
questions.correctAnswer: Execution of one process does not depend on any other process
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Execution of one process does not depend on any other process.

questions.questionText: Future.value, Future.error and Future.delayed are all:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Ways of creating a Future.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a state of a Future?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Finished.

questions.questionText: True or False: Synchronous programs require more threads to handle more requests.
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) True.

questions.questionText: True or False: await can be used on any ordinary non-async function.
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) False.

questions.questionText: Which statement best describes a synchronous process?
options: It runs on a separate thread without waiting
It waits for an operation to complete before starting another
questions.correctAnswer: It waits for an operation to complete before starting another
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) It waits for an operation to complete before starting another.
